confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Hong Kong price levels, calibrated to the supplied comparables and not checked against live listings. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies by season and lead time. Cocktail and wine_glass are set from Hong Kong bar and restaurant levels and cross-checked against beer (about 2.5x and 1.9x). FX value taken from search-result summaries of RBA pages that I did not open directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Calibrated to Taipei, Kyoto and Nara. Hong Kong sits roughly 1.6 to 2.6 times Taipei's levels across the anchors, and is above Kyoto on all anchors except inexpensive meals, where it is close.
